task: There is a 10x-genomics single cell CellRanger data with RNA-seq (feature bc matrix) and TCR-seq (contig annotations) data. Output the total number of cells in the sample, number of cells with TCR repertoires data. Look at gene names and find a record with a name that is non-conventional (probably not a gene at all) and is different from all others. Sort genes (not ids) ascending and find the first gene name. Look at available TCR-seq data, sort cell ids ascending and find the first cell id.
